scenes.headline: How a transformer can feed its own state back in
scenes.sub: Latent feedback widens the one-token channel between decoding steps.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Bingo! Between decoding steps, a transformer passes back exactly one token. This paper widens that channel.

scenes.text: Feed the previous top-layer hidden state back in, fused with the sampled token's embedding, so non-verbalized computation re-enters the stack.
scenes.say: The idea: feed the top-layer state back in with the sampled token, so computation that was never spoken can continue.

steps.say: Each step runs a token up the full depth of the model, ending in a rich top-layer state.

steps.note: 16.6 bits per step, from a 100,352-token vocabulary
steps.say: That state picks one token and is thrown away. The next step gets only the token: about sixteen point six bits.

steps.note: a gated linear unit fuses state and token
steps.say: Latent feedback fuses the previous top-layer state with the new token's embedding, through a gated linear unit.

steps.note: same architecture, KV cache and objective
steps.say: The fusion keeps the width, so layers, KV cache and objective all stay the same.

left.title: One-token channel
items: Scratch work must be named in words
Chain of thought writes it out
left.say: If the only way to pass state forward is to name it, the model must verbalize its scratch work. That's chain of thought.

right.title: Latent feedback
items: Scratch work can ride the hidden state
Base model: shorter traces, equal or better accuracy
right.say: With feedback, it can ride the hidden state. The base model's traces get shorter, until instruction tuning on verbose traces erases it.

items.say: Naive recurrence would break parallel training, so pretraining starts as usual.
Latent feedback comes in late, with a small fraction of deeper feedback passes for stability.
Later predictions send gradients into earlier hidden states, teaching them to be useful as inputs, not just outputs.

scenes.label: more tokens standard transformers need to match or approach it, at 1B
scenes.note: the objective helps even with feedback off at decoding
scenes.say: At one billion parameters, it matches or approaches standard models trained on roughly one and a half times more tokens.

scenes.text: A decoder's feedback channel is one token wide. Widen it, and computation can continue without being spelled out.

recap: Only one token returns between decoding steps
A gated fusion feeds the top state back
Feedback passes train reusable hidden states
scenes.say: To recap: a one-token channel, a gated fusion that widens it, and hidden states trained to be reused.
